text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While we're on our way back from an
outing,
Mejiro Bright comes to a stop in
front of a store
window.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! Just look at those ocean blue eyes. I
wonder
if she'd be friends with Maki.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Maki's my doll... and a precious
friend.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
She can be rather shy, but she gives
everything
her all, and she has a heart of
gold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like to take a closer look at the
doll. This
may take some time, so do feel
free to head back
without me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I let her know I'd like to accompany her,
and we go inside. The shop is full of
antiques and dolls of all shapes and
sizes... It's like standing inside a fairy
tale.
choice_data_list: Bright, if it's alright with you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: They're all gorgeous... The one with the blue eyes, this one with snow-white hair... Sigh... Oh, and this little one, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That doll over there would look stunning
in a dress with a scala lace trim... Oh,
they're all so
adorable. I simply cannot
make up my mind. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're absolutely right! Look closer,
and you
can see the subtle differences in
their
expressions, yes?
choice_data_list: Each of them has their own good po...
Each of them has their own charm, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This one with the curled eyelashes has
an
outgoing personality, while the one
with the
pouty lips looks bashful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
She is indeed! And that's why she needs
a friend to give her the extra push she
needs, just as Ryan
and Dober have with
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What to do... The pink one is cute, but
it's a
little...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Dober! ♪ Are you shopping as
well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright?! I, um,
well... just wandered in on
a whim!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting a new teacup, you see!
There were some nice ones in the shop
window, so I came inside to have a look!
It's not like I was attracted by the
adorable items here! Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: M-more importantly! It's surprising to see you here, Bright! And with company, no less!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're quite right. Trainer is here
to offer
some assistance in my search for
a friend for
Maki.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Maki... Is she the one we often had
tea
parties with when we were little?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she's my dear friend... and my
treasure.

text_block_list.name: Shop Staff
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the wait, Miss Dober.
About your
membership card—
choice_data_list: You two have always gotten along s...
You two have always gotten along s...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...?! O-oh! You mean the card I
happened to find on the floor?! You've
found the owner? Fantastic!
I'll just be
on my way, then!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I have somewhere to be!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please excuse me! I wish you
success in
your search.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It seems Dober is rather busy. As for me,
though, I think I'll be needing a little
more time to decide
who I'll be taking
home...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is that all right with you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you! ♪ I'll be sure to find the
perfect
companion for Maki!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright closely examines all the
dolls in the
shop... but closing time
arrives before she can
make up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The one with ruby-red eyes was so delightful! But the one with the ocean blue eyes had the air of an older sister... Oh, but then... so did the one with amber eyes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Should I bring them all home? But then
Maki
would be overwhelmed by all the
new faces!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I am. I enjoy this time as well, you
see—the
time spent weighing up
options.
choice_data_list: You look pretty happy for someone ...
You look pretty happy for someone ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But... it seems time is a luxury we no
longer have.
I do hope you're not too
tired, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You grace me with such kind
words.
Thank you.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to see you having s...
I'm glad I got to see you having s...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! As I tend to conduct these
searches on my own, having some
company made for a surprisingly nice
change of pace. Today was a lot
of fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've so very many things to tell Maki
when I get
home! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've so very many things to tell Maki
when I get
home! ♪
choice_data_list: There really are so many ways to e...
There really are so many ways to e...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, firstly, I'll tell her about Dober.
She mentioned that she was looking for
a teacup, so
I'll discuss with Maki which
one to gift her.
choice_data_list: There really are so many ways to e...
There really are so many ways to e...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'd also like to discuss a design idea
that came to
me while I was looking for a new
friend for her.
And then, lastly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wish to share your kind words with her,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can only hope we manage to
cover
everything before sunrise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her gently to try and get to sleep
at a
decent hour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! If you're curious, do consider
taking
one home for yourself. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Meeting new friends is difficult, but the
process is
so much fun... Perhaps you
know the feeling?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that fate will guide you to a
wondrous
encounter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I eagerly await the day we can all enjoy
a tea
party together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Mejiro Bright
cheerfully tells
me all about the wonders
of dolls.
